slides.idea: What makes a Studio slide readable?
slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "What makes a Studio slide readable?"
Three rule cards in a row across the middle, each with a small drawing:
 Card 1 "One idea, a plain question": a small slide with one big question mark
 Card 2 "Name who acts, label each arrow": two boxes "Human" and "Agent", an arrow each way labelled "asks" and "draws"
 Card 3 "One slide for a whole life": one wide slide holding a small loop of four dots
Bottom-right sticky note: "Still open: one style per Project or per deck?"
Focal point: card 2.
slides.notes: Leaning: agreed (b34 s02-D01 to b34 s02-D03). Still open: One style per Project, or per deck?

slides.idea: Is a deck shown at a meeting a delivery?
slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "Is a deck shown at a meeting a delivery?"
Three option cards across the middle, joined by a wavy line:
 Card A "Yes, into delivery/": a small deck dropping into a parcel box labelled "delivery/"
 Card B "No, a round in the topic", circled in orange with a small tag "leaning": a meeting table with a notebook labelled "pass"
 Card C "Only the agreed version": a deck with a green tick, then an arrow into the box
Bottom-right sticky note: "Still open: a deck sent by email?"
Focal point: card B.
slides.notes: Leaning: the second (proposal 261029): a meeting is a round; `delivery/` gets only the agreed version (b35-s01-D11). Still open: Does a deck sent by email count differently?
